messages:
rachel: Design request for the upcoming benchmark launch — need a small batch of assets for comms and SDRs. Target: first proofs by Wednesday 10AM PT.

diego: High-level brief so design can triage:
 • hero webinar banner 1600x600 (animated webp with gentle pulse on cost line)
 • benchmark infographic carousel: 1200x1200 x3 tiles (PNG + animated GIF)
 • one-page sales sheet (print-ready PDF A4 + web PNG) with 3 inset callouts and a tiny methodology box
 • localized CTA snippets for FR/DE (short lines only)
 • tiny email header: 600x200 (PNG)

lena: Export specs:
 • hero: webp (looping, 6s), fallback JPG 1600x600, source Figma + SVG exports
 • tiles: SVG for web, 2x PNG for retina, GIF capped at 2MB, <3 frames recommended
 • one-pager: PDF/X-1a for print, high-res PNG for email, include crop marks
 • fonts: Inter variable for headings, Inter Regular for body

rachel: Visual guidance: keep charts minimal — show three metrics: median latency (ms), throughput (r/s), and $/1k tokens. Use tri-tone palette: Redwood blue #0069FF, Slate #2B2F33, Accent green #00B37E. No large hero gradients; micro-gradient allowed behind legend only. Include small grayscale variant for internal slide decks.

lena: Accessibility checklist required: alt text for each image (1-2 sentences), text contrast ratios, and readable font sizes for slides (min 18px body on web).

rachel: Here's the sample CSV for the tiles (please use for annotations):
```
model,name,median_latency_ms,throughput_rps,cost_per_1k_usd
raven-2,open,92,210,0.19
redwood-core,redwood,36,620,0.24
apollo-xx,commercial,75,310,0.48
```

diego: Animation notes: for the hero webp, animate the cost line with a subtle ease-in-out draw and loop once then hold. For GIF tiles, prefer cross-fade between frames rather than janky redraws.

rachel: Legal/Compliance: EU copy must avoid phrases implying user data processing. Use "inference economics" and neutral benefit statements. No SLA claims in external assets. Marco will provide localized CTAs after initial pass.

marco: FR/DE CTAs coming — sending 2 short variants each by EOD. Example FR: "Voir le benchmark"; DE: "Benchmark ansehen" — will confirm tone with localization team.

design-bot: Task created: MARKETING-5012 1 Assets: benchmark tiles, webinar hero, one-pager. Owner: @lena. Due: 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. Preview links will be posted.

lena: Working on wireframes now. Quick Q: do we want the one-pager to include the small methodology footnote (link) or embed a tiny table of the dataset? I prefer link + an inline 3-line summary for clarity.

rachel: Link + 3-line summary please. Also include a short writer-approved copy blurb for the email header: "Webinar: Making inference predictable and economical." Keep under 60 chars.

lena: Great. I'll upload Figma with separate frames for color + grayscale, and include alt text drafts in the file. Posting thumbnails here when ready. ETA proofs: Wed 10AM PT. :rocket:

design-bot: Previews scheduled: https://preview.redwood.ai/marketer/5012 (will populate when frames export complete).
